newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast lt. crude retreats in thin session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast lt. crude retreats in thin session.

text.p: U.S. West Coast light crude prices retreated with lower values for West Texas Intermediate (WTI) in a quiet session for Alaskan crude, traders said Monday.

Traders remained uncertain if a cargo of Alaska North Slope (ANS) crude sold late last week at a higher price than the $1.53 discount done January 8. A rumor ANS was done better than that level circulated Friday.
With the grade's dominant seller, BP America, out of the market, and other producers ARCO and Exxon declining comment, it was unclear who could have done the trade, buyers said.
